style: Night set in Maya's room: deep blue window with moon and stars, warm desk-lamp glow on Maya (round glasses, pencil bun) behind the desk, Floey perched on the laptop lid facing her. Amber stat pills in the room bookend the reel ('0 clicks' at the open, 'Search: Off' flipping to 'Search: On' at the fix). There is one cutaway insert (URL Inspection) and no notification.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya alone under the desk-lamp glow. A red '0 clicks' stat pill sits by her shoulder inside the frame and a '!' mark is above her bun. Floey is out of frame.
panels.action: Frame one, already panicking: Maya is in the cheeks pose (both hands on her cheeks) with a worried face and wide eyes behind her round glasses as she starts the line. The '!' mark pops in above the bun and the bun wobbles.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya, the '0 clicks' pill and the '!' mark
panels.action: On 'They took mine!' Maya jolts. Her hands fly up into the panic pose and her face goes full panic. A small panic shake runs for under half a second, then settles.

panels.subject: wide: Floey perched on the laptop lid (floeyLaptop), with Maya behind the desk
panels.action: Hard cut to the two-shot. The '0 clicks' pill fades out on the cut. Floey says her line deadpan, with a slow blink and a small head tilt. Maya freezes in the cheeks pose and only her eyes slide sideways to Floey (look x -1).

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone, Floey out of frame
panels.action: Maya drops her hands to the rest pose with an annoyed face and gives a flat, defiant stare off frame left toward Floey. On 'Floey' her head tilts a little, as if she's being patient.

panels.subject: floey: a closer two-shot favouring Floey on the laptop lid, with Maya soft at the edge of frame
panels.action: Floey gives a short chip on 'It does' and then a knowing head tilt. A slow push-in sells the correction. At the edge of frame Maya's eyebrows go up (surprised).

panels.subject: wide: Maya at the laptop, Floey on the lid
panels.action: Maya goes into the type pose with her eyes down at the laptop (look 0, 1) and a think face. She pastes the link, then hits enter. Floey turns to watch the screen.

panels.subject: The only cutaway: a laptop screen DUO.listInsert titled 'URL Inspection', sub-line '/lisbon-on-a-budget (example)'
panels.action: The insert swings in during the pause and its rows slide in one by one: 'Status' / 'URL is not on Google' (bad), 'Page fetch' / 'Successful' (good), 'Last crawl' / '1 day ago (example)', then the hi row 'Page indexing' / 'URL marked noindex'. A ring grows around the hi row.

panels.subject: The same URL Inspection insert, with the ring on 'URL marked noindex'
panels.action: The insert holds while Maya reads the two rows aloud (voice over). A gentle push-in toward the ringed row, and the ring pulses once on 'no index'.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya alone, Floey out of frame
panels.action: On 'Who did that?' the insert whooshes away and we cut to Maya leaning in toward the screen (leanTo forward) with an annoyed face, narrowed eyes and her gaze down at the laptop. A slow push-in on her suspicion.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone on the laptop lid
panels.action: Floey looks smug and turns her head from Maya toward the laptop screen with a slow tilt. 'You did' lands perfectly dry and she doesn't blink.

panels.subject: wide: both, with a red stat pill appearing by Maya's head (x about 880, y about 610)
panels.action: On 'One little switch' the camera pulls out to show both of them. A red 'Search: Off' pill pops up by Maya's head. Maya's eyes go from the pill to Floey and her face goes surprised.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya, with the red 'Search: Off' pill inside the frame by her shoulder. Floey is out of frame.
panels.action: Maya says 'Oh.' with a surprised face, which melts to sad as she slumps into the facepalm pose. Her bun wobbles on the slump.

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone with the pill by her head
panels.action: No words: Maya peels her hand off her face, goes into the type pose and taps one key. The pill flips from red 'Search: Off' to green 'Search: On'.

panels.subject: wide: Maya behind the desk, Floey on the laptop lid
panels.action: Maya goes back to the rest pose. Her face brightens (happy) as it dawns on her, and she looks over at Floey (look x -1) as she asks. Floey gives a slow, satisfied blink. The green pill fades out.

panels.subject: floey: a closer two-shot favouring Floey on the laptop lid, with Maya at the edge of frame
panels.action: Floey lifts her chin, flicks her tongue and gives a fond half-blink on 'Maya'. At the edge of frame Maya gives a small proud nod. There's a slight push-in.

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone, Floey out of frame
panels.action: Maya looks up at the ceiling (look 0, -1), tilts her head back and goes into the shrug pose with a sheepish, sad face as she apologises to Google.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone on the laptop lid
panels.action: Floey pivots to face the camera, puffs her chest and delivers the line perfectly dry, then preens one feather.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya alone under the lamp light
panels.action: The button: Maya has a deadpan face and turns her eyes to the lens, giving the camera a long, flat look over her glasses. There's a very slow push-in and the look holds for about 2.5 seconds until the end card arrives.
